mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has risen each of the last three weeks (-28.6 to -19.6), signaling a steady return to commuting routines. This recovery in weekday out-of-home activity should continue to lift ancillary retail and recreation visits over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days is not higher than prior 28 days despite WORKPLACES continuing its upward trend through the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has improved from -51.0 to -45.6 over four weeks. If TRANSIT crosses a recovery threshold of improving more than 5 points cumulatively from its trough, it signals renewed willingness to travel for non-essential trips, which should raise RETAIL_REC within two weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise within two weeks of TRANSIT crossing the 5-point recovery threshold, or TRANSIT reverses below the threshold before the horizon completes.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the week following a joint PARKS decline and RESIDENTIAL decline, indicating no substitution effect between outdoor and indoor activity.
